title: events/types/retry.loop.completed
description: Payload for event_type 'retry.loop.completed' (native type, feature 003; FR-205/FR-207): terminal loop outcome. early_exit = gate passed at the final iteration; exhausted = retry cap or mutation-space exhaustion; aborted = named-error termination (budget, reload mismatch, bridge failure) -- never a hang or silent stop.

iterations.description: Windows actually run (1 initial + retries used).

max_retries.description: Configured retry cap echoed for the record.

mutations_applied.description: Mutations that applied cleanly (rejected ones are excluded).

reason.description: Named termination reason; 'gate_passed' pairs with early_exit.

error.description: Structured failure detail for aborted loops (shared error grammar, minus retryable which is always false here).
